General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Door Latch for the Passengers Side Door on Samurai™s from 86′ thru 90′.
NOTE: Use The Existing Arms by Simply Removing C-Clip to take off Arm and Re-Install Opposite way.Also fits the Tin Top.
I also sell these for the 91′ thru 95′ Samurai’s
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Door Latch – RH (Passenger Side)
Qty 3 – Lock Clips
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1990 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1990 All Models
